patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Frame: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.. Choose Salesforce Commerce Cloud only if your buying job matches “Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; ” rather than Square Online's shape. Choose Square Online only if your buying job matches “Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, ” rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud's shape. Workflow advantage: Salesforce Commerce Cloud leans wholesale-b2b, catalog-management; Square Online leans omnichannel-retail. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; enterprise SaaS landscape, not an SMB Shopify subs; Square Online is Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, Premium $149/location; 30-day trials on paid tiers.
- Company-size focus: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (mid-market, enterprise) vs Square Online (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Salesforce Commerce Cloud-leaning wholesale-b2b, catalog-management vs Square Online-leaning omnichannel-retail.
- Researched limits: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Square Online — Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify.

Limitations — Salesforce Commerce Cloud: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Implementation is a multi-month SI programme, not a weekend theme install; Square Online: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Free tier online processing spread (3.3% + 30¢) can exceed paid-tier savings at volume.

Poor-fit cases: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet · Square Online is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify · Avoid Salesforce Commerce Cloud if you actually need Square Online's motion (Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
